tagline.en: Crop loans at an effective 4% interest

source.quote: Farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers engaged in cultivation are eligible.
The borrower should be between 18 and 75 years of age

summary.en: Loans up to ₹3,00,000 at an effective 4% interest

source.quote: Short-term loans up to ₹3,00,000 at 7% interest, with an additional 3% prompt repayment incentive, making the effective rate 4% per year.

summary.en: Apply at any bank branch (commercial, RRB or cooperative).
summary.hi: किसी भी बैंक शाखा (वाणिज्यिक, RRB या सहकारी) में आवेदन करें।
summary.te: ఏ బ్యాంకు శాఖలోనైనా (వాణిజ్య, RRB లేదా సహకార) దరఖాస్తు చేయండి.

source.quote: Apply at any commercial bank, regional rural bank or cooperative bank branch
